text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a regularly scheduled physical

evaluation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahh... I knew it! It's just as I thought!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well, it's about my weight, you see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't gone up at all, despite
indulging in
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And despite the fact I no longer train as

excessively as I used to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's because I've been getting
the proper
nutrients from the meal plan
you made for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude once
again for
your painstaking guidance,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen and I renew our
determination
to continue working hard
together.
